questions.content:
Part 4. Writing
Write an essay in English at least 80 words about "How to reduce road accident in Cambodia?".

ai.answer: Model essay (AI): "How to Reduce Road Accidents in Cambodia" — the problem, actions for road users, actions for the authorities, conclusion. Tap Show the working to read it.
steps: Plan: the problem, actions for road users, actions for the authorities, conclusion.
Road accidents kill thousands of people in Cambodia every year, and many of them could be prevented.

Road users can make the biggest difference. Drivers and riders should always wear a helmet or seat belt, keep to the speed limit, never drink and drive, and not use their phone while driving. Parents should not let young children ride motorbikes.
The authorities also have a role. They should enforce the traffic law fairly, improve roads, lights and signs, and teach road safety in schools and on TV.
If everyone respects the rules, our roads will be much safer for all.
Check: an introduction, one idea per paragraph with examples, linking words (first, moreover, however, in conclusion) and a short conclusion.

questions.content:
Part 4. Writing
Write an essay in English at least 80 words about "Your goal in the future".

ai.answer: Model essay (AI): "My Goal in the Future" — my goal, why, how I will reach it, conclusion. Tap Show the working to read it.
steps: Plan: my goal, why, how I will reach it, conclusion.
My goal in the future is to become a doctor and work in my home province.

I chose this goal because many people in the countryside cannot get good medical care. When my grandmother was ill, we had to travel a long way to the hospital, and I saw how important a good doctor is.

To reach my goal, I will study hard for the BacII exam, especially biology and chemistry, and then apply to the University of Health Sciences. I will also improve my English so that I can read medical books and research.
It will take many years, but I believe that with patience and hard work I can make my dream come true and help my community.
Check: an introduction, one idea per paragraph with examples, linking words (first, moreover, however, in conclusion) and a short conclusion.

questions.content:
Part 4. Writing
Write an essay "Studying for Success" at least 80 words.

ai.answer: Model essay (AI): "Studying for Success" — introduction, plan and habits, method, health, conclusion. Tap Show the working to read it.
steps: Plan: introduction, plan and habits, method, health, conclusion.
Success at school does not come from luck but from good study habits.

First, students should make a timetable and study a little every day instead of trying to learn everything the night before an exam. Second, they should study actively: take notes in their own words, practise past exam papers, and ask the teacher or friends when they do not understand. Studying in a quiet place without phone distractions also helps.
Finally, health matters. Enough sleep, good food and some exercise keep the mind fresh.
In short, students who plan, practise regularly and look after themselves will be ready to succeed.
Check: an introduction, one idea per paragraph with examples, linking words (first, moreover, however, in conclusion) and a short conclusion.

questions.content:
IV. Writing
Write an essay "Role of women in modern Cambodia society" at least 80 words.

ai.answer: Model essay (AI): "The Role of Women in Modern Cambodian Society" — introduction, family, work and economy, public life, conclusion. Tap Show the working to read it.
steps: Plan: introduction, family, work and economy, public life, conclusion.
In the past, Cambodian women were expected to stay at home. Today their role has grown far beyond the family.

Women are still at the heart of the family: they care for children and elderly parents and often manage the household money. At the same time, many women now work outside the home. They run businesses in markets, work in garment factories, banks and schools, and send money home from abroad, so they are a major force in the economy.
Women are also more active in public life. More girls finish school and go to university, and women serve as doctors, teachers, officials and members of parliament.
However, women still face challenges such as lower pay and violence. With equal education and opportunities, they can contribute even more to the development of Cambodia.
Check: an introduction, one idea per paragraph with examples, linking words (first, moreover, however, in conclusion) and a short conclusion.

questions.content:
Part 4: Writing
Writing an essay. There is too much traffic in the city. "What do you think the authorities should do about it?" at least 80 words.

ai.answer: Model essay (AI): "Too Much Traffic in the City" — the problem, three actions for the authorities, conclusion. Tap Show the working to read it.
steps: Plan: the problem, three actions for the authorities, conclusion.
Traffic jams in Phnom Penh waste time, burn fuel and pollute the air. The authorities should act in several ways.

First, they should improve public transport, with more city buses on clear routes, so that people can leave their cars and motorbikes at home. Second, they should enforce traffic laws strictly, especially against illegal parking on roads and pavements, which blocks the traffic. Third, they should plan the city better: build ring roads, fix traffic lights and move some offices, schools and markets away from the centre.
If these steps are taken and people follow the rules, the city will become safer, cleaner and easier to live in.
Check: an introduction, one idea per paragraph with examples, linking words (first, moreover, however, in conclusion) and a short conclusion.

IV. Writing
Write an essay "Life in the countryside" at least 180 words.

ai.answer: Model essay (AI): "Life in the Countryside" — introduction, advantages, disadvantages, conclusion. Tap Show the working to read it.
steps: Plan: introduction, advantages, disadvantages, conclusion.
Most Cambodians were born in the countryside or have family there. Life in a village is very different from life in Phnom Penh, and it has both strong points and weak points.

One great advantage of country life is the clean and peaceful environment. The air is fresh, there is little traffic and people can enjoy green rice fields, rivers and quiet evenings. Food is also fresh and cheap because many families grow their own vegetables and raise animals. In addition, villagers usually know and help each other, so there is a strong sense of community.

On the other hand, the countryside has some disadvantages. There are fewer jobs, so many young people move to the city or abroad to earn money. Schools, hospitals and markets may be far away, and roads can be poor in the rainy season. Some villages still lack clean water, electricity or internet.

In conclusion, life in the countryside is calm and healthy, but it offers fewer opportunities. If the government improves roads, schools and services, more people will be happy to stay and build their future there.
Check: an introduction, one idea per paragraph with examples, linking words (first, moreover, however, in conclusion) and a short conclusion.

IV. Writing
Write an essay "What make a good parent" at least 180 words.

ai.answer: Model essay (AI): "What Makes a Good Parent" — introduction, love and time, guidance and example, support for education, conclusion. Tap Show the working to read it.
steps: Plan: introduction, love and time, guidance and example, support for education, conclusion.
Being a parent is one of the most important jobs in the world, but there is no school that teaches it. In my view, a good parent has several qualities.

First of all, a good parent gives love and time. Children need to feel safe and valued. Parents who listen to their children, play with them and talk about their problems help them grow up happy and confident.

Secondly, a good parent guides children and sets a good example. Children copy what they see, so parents should be honest, polite and hard-working themselves. They should also set clear rules and explain why the rules matter, rather than simply punishing.

Thirdly, a good parent supports their children's education. This does not only mean paying for school, but also encouraging them to study, showing interest in their progress and helping them choose their future path.

In conclusion, good parents are not perfect people. They are people who love their children, guide them patiently and help them become responsible adults. Their reward is to see their sons and daughters grow into kind, confident and useful members of society.
Check: an introduction, one idea per paragraph with examples, linking words (first, moreover, however, in conclusion) and a short conclusion.

IV. Writing
Write an essay "The value of Higher Education" at least 180 words.

ai.answer: Model essay (AI): "The Value of Higher Education" — introduction, better jobs, personal growth, benefits to the country, conclusion. Tap Show the working to read it.
steps: Plan: introduction, better jobs, personal growth, benefits to the country, conclusion.
After finishing high school, many young Cambodians wonder whether they should continue to university. In my opinion, higher education has great value, both for the individual and for society.

First, a university degree opens the door to better jobs. Employers look for people with specialist knowledge and skills, so graduates usually find work more easily and earn higher salaries. This helps them support their families and improve their standard of living.

Second, higher education helps people grow. Students learn to think critically, solve problems, work in teams and express their ideas clearly. They also meet people from different backgrounds and become more confident and independent.

Finally, educated citizens are important for the development of the country. Cambodia needs doctors, engineers, teachers and business leaders to build a strong economy and a fair society. Graduates can also share what they have learned with their families and communities, so the benefits spread far beyond the university.
In conclusion, higher education is an investment that brings rewards for a whole lifetime. Students who have the chance to study further should take it and work hard.
Check: an introduction, one idea per paragraph with examples, linking words (first, moreover, however, in conclusion) and a short conclusion.

IV. Writing
Write an essay "Advantages and Disadvantages of TV" at least 180 words.

ai.answer: Model essay (AI): "Advantages and Disadvantages of TV" — introduction, advantages, disadvantages, conclusion. Tap Show the working to read it.
steps: Plan: introduction, advantages, disadvantages, conclusion.
Television is found in almost every home in Cambodia today. Like most inventions, it brings both benefits and problems, so it is worth looking at both sides.

First, TV is an important source of news and information. People can follow what is happening in the country and around the world, learn about health, farming or the weather, and watch educational programmes that help students with their lessons. Moreover, TV is a cheap form of entertainment: after a long day, families can relax together and enjoy films, music and sport.

However, television also has disadvantages. Many people, especially children, spend too many hours in front of the screen instead of studying, playing outside or talking with their family. This can harm their health and their results at school. In addition, some programmes show violence or advertisements that encourage people to buy things they do not need.

In conclusion, TV is neither good nor bad in itself. If we choose useful programmes and limit the time we spend watching, it can be a valuable tool for learning and relaxing. Parents in particular should guide their children and switch the TV off at homework time.
Check: an introduction, one idea per paragraph with examples, linking words (first, moreover, however, in conclusion) and a short conclusion.
